offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Chakra is the energy of your body and your spirit, mixed together. Every jutsu starts with it.

offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Focus it now. Feel it gathering. (Press G for Chakra Control.)

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Good, I can feel it from here! Now hold that chakra in the soles of your feet... and walk up the Academy's wall to the roof.

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Too little and you fall. Too much and you're blasted off. Keep it steady!

steps.text: Walk up the Academy wall to its roof

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: You made it to the top on your first try? Even Sasuke needed two! Well done.
